mechanism_one_line: Rollup proof committed to a full 32-row inner chunk but L1 settlement processed only numRealTxs rows (attacker-set, not bound to the proof); fake deposit rows past numRealTxs were proved but never settled, then real withdrawals at row 0 paid out
notes: source_grade=SECONDARY for the root cause; loss_confirmed is Aztec Labs' own statement ('~$2.1m was transferred') quoted verbatim by rekt (Aztec X post and incident report not retrieved directly; slowmist.medium page was Cloudflare-blocked). Attack tx 0x074ec931...eeb1: 908.99 ETH, 270,513 DAI, 167.89 wstETH, yvDAI/yvWETH/LUSD/yvLUSD (~$2.19M). A second attacker reused the flaw on 2026-06-15 for ~$88K; claimed total $2.28M (rekt). Contract immutable, admin keys renounced April 2024; no recovery. Alternative label P1 (proved effect not bound to executed effect); P5 chosen because the defect is a count mismatch between what the proof covers and what the contract reads. Repo AztecProtocol/aztec-connect ALLOWED but not opened.
